King Ai of Zhou
(
Chinese

Ji Quji

king
of China's
Zhou dynasty
. He was the eldest son of
King Zhending
.
[
1

He succeeded his father in 441 BC, but was killed by his younger brother,
Shuxi
(King Si), after only three months on the throne.
